Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the relevant director by conflating the English title “Gently My Songs Entreat” with the British release “Unfinished Symphony” and pivoted to Anthony Asquith, despite the initial web result clearly showing the 1933 film “Gently My Songs Entreat (Leise flehen meine Lieder)” was directed by Willi Forst. This led the team to research the wrong person’s birthplace (London) instead of Forst’s (Vienna/Viennese), causing the incorrect solution.
